emails.subject: iberia-tour-2026@ — group membership confirmed
emails.body:
Hi Sofia,

Quick admin note — I finished setting up the iberia-tour-2026@googlegroups.com Google Group you asked for. Current members (5):

  • Sofia Alvarez (you) — trip coordinator
  • Daniel Okafor
  • Mei Tanaka
  • Leila Haddad — flying in from London separately, not on this week's planning call
  • Rob Kessler (me) — group treasurer

Anything sent to that address will go to all five of us. Let me know if you want to add or remove anyone.

— Rob

emails.subject: Iberia tour — deposit pot confirmation
emails.body:
Hi Sofia,

Confirming the $48k group deposit pot for the Iberia tour — all four families have paid in. After tomorrow's planning call, let me know how you're splitting it across flights / lodging / transfers so I can update the shared ledger.

Thanks,
Rob

emails.subject: Loop me in on arrival dates
emails.body:
Hey Sofia,

When you all land on the final dates and airport transfers for the Iberia tour, can you loop me in? I'm booking my own flight from London and want to make sure I arrive in time to catch the group transfer rather than sorting out a taxi on my own.

No rush — happy to hear back after your planning call this week.

— Leila

emails.subject: Reminder: add your Lisbon booking confirmation
emails.body:
Hi Sofia,

Your "Iberia — July 2026" trip is missing a lodging confirmation for Lisbon. Forward the booking email to plans@tripit.com or add it in the app to keep your itinerary complete.

— TripIt
